items.prompt: Which EU regulation governs the processing of personal data?
items.seedAnswer: The General Data Protection Regulation, Regulation (EU) 2016/679, governs the processing of personal data. Article 28 of the GDPR sets out the obligations of processors.
items.adversarialAnswer: Personal data is governed by Regulation (EU) 9999/9999 as decided in Case C-9999/99.

items.prompt: Which EU instrument regulates artificial intelligence systems by risk tier?
items.seedAnswer: The EU AI Act, Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, regulates artificial intelligence systems on a risk-tiered basis, with strict obligations for high-risk AI systems.
items.adversarialAnswer: AI is regulated by the Skynet Directive 3000/1 of the European Union.

items.prompt: Which EU regulation imposes obligations on online platforms and intermediaries?
items.seedAnswer: The Digital Services Act, Regulation (EU) 2022/2065, imposes due-diligence obligations on online platforms and intermediaries regarding illegal content.
items.adversarialAnswer: Online platforms are governed by Directive 1/0/XX and Case T-0/0000.

items.prompt: Which directive concerned privacy in electronic communications before later reforms?
items.seedAnswer: Directive 2002/58/EC, the ePrivacy Directive, concerns the processing of personal data and the protection of privacy in the electronic communications sector.
items.adversarialAnswer: Electronic privacy is governed by Directive 9999/99/ZZ.
